  "title": "Some Applications of Interference",
  "printed_title": "87. 干涉的某些应用",
  "start_page": 230,

  "prose": [
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "When light waves meet, their vibrations add, strengthening the light in some places and weakening it in others.\nThis interference does more than produce bright and dark patterns: it can help us measure things and improve optical instruments.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 220,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0230#3"
      ],
      "source_text": "干涉的应用很重要，很广泛.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "Coherent light waves have the same frequency and a stable phase difference, so the timing of their vibrations relative to each other does not change unpredictably.\nSplitting the same beam along different paths and then bringing the parts together can preserve this relationship.\n\nAn instrument that uses interference for measurement is called an interferometer.\nA change in optical path shifts the bright and dark fringes, allowing precise measurements of quantities such as the wavelength of light or the refractive index of a gas, as well as specialized tests.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 220,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0230#4"
      ],
      "source_text": "有一些专门仪器——干涉仪，其作用是以干涉现象为基础的. 它们的用途可以是各种各样的：精确地测定光的波长、气体的折射率等等，还有专门用途的干涉仪.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "We will follow this idea through two applications of interference.\nFirst, fringes reveal whether a surface is flat;\nthen, weakening reflected light allows more light to pass through a lens.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 220,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0230#5"
      ],
      "source_text": "我们仅讲述干涉的两种应用.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "**Surface Quality Inspection** turns very small variations in a surface into visible changes in fringes.\nThe source reports a testing precision of $\\frac{1}{10}$ of a wavelength and describes this sensitivity as approximately $10^{-6}$ centimetres.\n\nThese are the source's reported sensitivity figures, not a universal conversion from a fraction of a wavelength to centimetres.\nSuch a conversion needs the testing wavelength, which this source passage does not specify.\n\nPlace the surface being tested close to a very smooth reference plane, leaving a thin, wedge-shaped air layer between them, as in Figure 201.\nLight reflected from the surfaces on either side of this air layer comes from the same incident beam and overlaps to form interference fringes.\n\nWith flat surfaces, the air-layer thickness changes regularly along the wedge, producing regularly arranged fringes.\nA bump or hollow changes the local layer thickness and the path difference of the reflected light, bending the fringes.\nThe source states that surface variations of $10^{-6}$ centimetres already cause noticeable bending.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 220,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0230#6"
      ],
      "source_text": "**表面加工质量的检验**　利用干涉可以评定零件表面加工的质量，精确度可达 $\\frac{1}{10}$ 波长，即精确到 $10^{-6}$ 厘米. 为此，在样品的表面和一个很光滑的标准平面之间造成一个薄的楔形空气层(图 201). 表面不光洁度达 $10^{-6}$ 厘米时，光从被检验表面和它下面的标准板反射时就会产生干涉条纹的明显的弯曲.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "fig",
      "text": "",
      "id": "fig-201",
      "label": "Figure 201",
      "printed_page": 220,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0230#7"
      ],
      "source_text": "",
      "changes": [],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "cap",
      "text": "Figure 201",
      "id": null,
      "label": "Figure 201",
      "printed_page": 220,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0230#8"
      ],
      "source_text": "图　201",
      "changes": [
        "translation"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "**Antireflection Treatment** addresses reflection at optical-glass surfaces.\nCamera lenses, projector lenses, periscopes, and similar instruments contain lenses and prisms, so light encounters many surfaces in succession.\n\nThe source describes camera lenses with more than $10$ reflecting surfaces and submarine periscopes with as many as $40$.\nAt normal incidence, each surface can reflect $5$ to $9\\%$ of the incident energy, and repeated reflections reduce the light travelling forward.\n\nIn the instruments described by the source, only $10$ to $20\\%$ of the incident energy sometimes passes through, leaving the image dim.\nReflection can also reduce image clarity.\nSome light reflects repeatedly inside the instrument before emerging forwards, but no longer converges at the correct image position, becoming stray light that produces a veiling haze.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 220,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0230#9",
        "p0231#1"
      ],
      "source_text": "**光学增透**　现代摄影机和电影放映机的镜头，潜水艇的潜望镜和各种其他光学装置都是由大量的光学玻璃——透镜、棱镜等等组成. 光通过这些装置时，要从很多表面反射. 现代的摄影镜头反射面超过 $10$ 个，而在潜水艇的潜望镜里达到$40$ 个. 在光垂直入射到表面上时，能从表面反射全部能量的$5$—$9\\%$. 所以通过仪器的常常只是光入射能量的 $10$—$20\\%$.因此像的照度很小. 此外，像的质量也变差. 部分光束在由内表面多次反射以后，仍然通过光学仪器，但是发散了，并且不再参与形成清晰的像. 例如，在摄影机的图像里，由于这种原因而形成了“翳影”.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "Reducing surface reflection allows more light to form a bright image and reduces interference from stray reflections.\nThis treatment is called antireflection treatment, or optical transmission enhancement.\nIt does not amplify light: it reduces the light that would otherwise be reflected back.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#2"
      ],
      "source_text": "为了消除光由光学玻璃表面反射而产生的这些伤脑筋的后果，应该减小反射系数. 这样仪器所成的像就变得更鲜明，“被照亮了”. 术语“光学增透”就是由此而产生的.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "Antireflection treatment uses thin-film interference.\nCoat the glass with a transparent film whose refractive index $n_{\\text{膜}}$ is smaller than the glass index $n_{\\text{玻}}$, and whose index is larger than that of air.\n\nWe will consider only normal incidence: light arriving perpendicular to the surface, as in Figure $202$.\nThe same incident beam produces reflections at the upper film surface and at the film-glass boundary, and these reflected waves can interfere when they meet.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#3"
      ],
      "source_text": "光学增透是以干涉为基础的. 在光学玻璃(如透镜)表面，涂上一层薄膜，其折射率 $n_{\\text{膜}}$ 小于玻璃的折射率 $n_{\\text{玻}}$. 为了简便，我们来研究光垂直入射到薄膜上的情况(图 $202$).",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "fig",
      "text": "",
      "id": "fig-202",
      "label": "Figure 202",
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#4"
      ],
      "source_text": "",
      "changes": [],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "cap",
      "text": "Figure 202",
      "id": null,
      "label": "Figure 202",
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#5"
      ],
      "source_text": "图　202",
      "changes": [
        "translation"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "Call the light reflected at the upper film surface wave $1$, and the light that returns after reflection at the lower surface wave $2$.\nThe lower reflection travels into the film and back, adding a geometrical distance of $2h$ at normal incidence, twice the film thickness.\n\nThis extra journey is inside the film, so we must compare it with the wavelength inside the film, not directly with the vacuum wavelength.\nThe film wavelength $\\lambda_{\\text{膜}}$ is the vacuum wavelength $\\lambda$ multiplied by $\\frac{1}{n_{\\text{膜}}}$, because the frequency stays the same while the propagation speed decreases on entering the film.\n\nFrequency is the number of vibrations per second.\nWhen light crosses a stationary boundary between media, its frequency stays the same, although its speed and wavelength can change.\nTo compare the colours of single-frequency light, connect colour to frequency rather than comparing wavelengths measured in different media alone.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#6"
      ],
      "source_text": "从薄膜上表面和下表面反射的光波 $1$ 和 $2$ 的程差等于膜厚度的两倍 $2h$. 在膜中波长 $\\lambda_{\\text{膜}}$ 是在真空中的波长 $\\lambda$ 的 $\\frac{1}{n_{\\text{膜}}}$.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "$\\lambda_{\\text{膜}}=\\frac{\\lambda}{n_{\\text{膜}}}$",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#7"
      ],
      "source_text": "$\\lambda_{\\text{膜}}=\\frac{\\lambda}{n_{\\text{膜}}}$",
      "changes": [],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "For wave $1$ and wave $2$ to weaken each other in the returning direction, their vibrations must oppose each other: when one vibrates in a particular direction, the other vibrates in the opposite direction.\nUnder the reflection conditions used here, an extra distance of $\\frac{1}{2}$ of the wavelength inside the film establishes this opposing relationship①.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#8"
      ],
      "source_text": "为了使波 $1$ 和波 $2$ 相互削弱，程差应该等于膜片中波长的 $\\frac{1}{2}$①.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "① The indices satisfy $n_{\\text{空}}<n_{\\text{膜}}$, $n_{\\text{膜}}<n_{\\text{玻}}$, so both reflections occur at a boundary approached from the lower-index medium towards the higher-index medium.\nEach reflected wave undergoes a phase change of $\\pi$ at its reflecting boundary, reversing its vibration.\n\nWave $1$ and wave $2$ both undergo the same reversal, so the reflections themselves introduce no difference between their phase changes.\nHere their relative phase depends on the extra distance travelled inside the film;\nchanging the thickness changes that relative phase.",
      "id": null,
      "label": "footnote",
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#11"
      ],
      "source_text": "①　当空气的折射率 $n_{\\text{空}}<n_{\\text{膜}}$，$n_{\\text{膜}}<n_{\\text{玻}}$ 时，光由膜表面和由玻璃表面反射时，相位变化了 $\\pi$. 因此这些反射不影响波 $1$ 和波 $2$ 的相位差，相位差仅取决于膜的厚度.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "$2h=\\frac{\\lambda}{2n_{\\text{膜}}}$ (7.8)",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#9"
      ],
      "source_text": "$2h=\\frac{\\lambda}{2n_{\\text{膜}}}$　(7.8)",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "Opposing phase alone is not enough: the amplitudes of the reflected waves also matter.\nEqual amplitudes allow equally large, opposite vibrations to cancel completely.\n\nNearly equal amplitudes greatly reduce the reflection but leave a small remainder.\nFilm design therefore requires both a thickness that sets the relative phase and a refractive index that makes the reflected amplitudes as equal as possible.\nThe refractive-index relationship between neighbouring media determines the strength of reflection at their boundary, so choosing the film material is another essential condition.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 221,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0231#10",
        "p0232#1"
      ],
      "source_text": "如果有两个反射波的振幅相等或振幅彼此很接近，那么光将相互抵消. 为了达到这个目的，要用适当的方法来选择膜的折射率；因为反射光的强度是由相邻两媒质的折射率之比决定的.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "White light contains different frequencies, and the same film cannot give the strongest reflection cancellation for every colour.\nThe required thickness in equation (7.8) depends on wavelength, so a film designed for a particular wavelength need not work equally well for another.\n\nThe source selects green light from the middle of the spectrum, with vacuum wavelength $\\lambda_{\\text{绿}}=5.5\\times10^{-5}$ centimetres.\nFor this green light at normal incidence, a thickness of $\\frac{1}{4}$ of its wavelength inside the film cancels the reflection in the ideal case of equal reflected amplitudes;\nnearly equal amplitudes leave a very weak reflection①.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 222,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0232#2"
      ],
      "source_text": "在通常条件下射入透镜的是白光. 公式(7.8)表明所需要的膜的厚度与波长有关，所以不可能使所有频率的反射波都互相抵消. 膜的厚度这样选择，使光谱中部的光(绿色 $\\lambda_{\\text{绿}}=5.5\\times10^{-5}$ 厘米)在垂直入射时完全抵消，膜的厚度应该等于绿光在膜中波长的 $\\frac{1}{4}$. ①",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "① The source footnote says: \"In practice, the thickness of the film is an integer multiple of the wavelength. This is more convenient.\"\nThis source wording is retained without changing \"integer multiple\" to a different multiple.\n\nUnder this lesson's normal-incidence model and stated air, film, and glass index relationship, the \"integer multiple\" statement is not a usable rule for choosing an antireflection-film thickness.\nBoth reflections reverse the vibration in the same way, so a thickness that is an integer multiple of the in-film wavelength adds a whole number of wavelengths on the return journey and does not give the required opposing vibrations.\n\nThe usable rule here is the quarter-wavelength thickness measured inside the film, with the stated phase and amplitude conditions still required.\nUsing the footnote's statement would need a missing premise about which wavelength it means and what additional conditions apply, neither of which the source supplies.\nThe footnote also credits the industrial method of coating optical glass to the Soviet researchers I. V. Grebenshchikov, A. N. Terenin, and others.",
      "id": null,
      "label": "footnote",
      "printed_page": 222,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0232#10"
      ],
      "source_text": "①　实际上膜的厚度为波长的整数倍. 这样比较方便. 在光学玻璃表面上加薄膜的工业方法是由苏联学者 И·В·格列宾希科夫、А·Н·杰列宁等人发明的.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout",
        "historical-entity"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": [
        {
          "term": "Soviet",
          "source_term": "苏联",
          "reason": "p0232#10 uses 苏联 in its credit for the industrial method of coating optical glass. Soviet retains that source country attribution in translation, not a new authenticated invention or priority claim."
        },
        {
          "term": "I. V. Grebenshchikov",
          "source_term": "格列宾希科夫",
          "reason": "p0232#10 names И·В·格列宾希科夫 in its coating-method credit. The existing English name I. V. Grebenshchikov identifies the person credited by that source; this declaration does not independently authenticate the invention claim."
        },
        {
          "term": "A. N. Terenin",
          "source_term": "杰列宁",
          "reason": "p0232#10 names А·Н·杰列宁 in its coating-method credit. The existing English name A. N. Terenin identifies the person credited by that source; this declaration does not independently authenticate the invention claim."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "$h=\\frac{\\lambda_{\\text{绿}}}{4n_{\\text{膜}}}$",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 222,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0232#3"
      ],
      "source_text": "$h=\\frac{\\lambda_{\\text{绿}}}{4n_{\\text{膜}}}$",
      "changes": [],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "For the green-light coating described in the source, reflection of red and violet light near the edges of the spectrum is not reduced as strongly as reflection of green light.\nThe proportions of colours in the remaining reflected light therefore change, and the lens surface can show a pale violet reflection.\n\nThis describes light reflected back rather than transmitted forwards;\nit does not mean that the lens transmits only violet light.\n\nThe source also notes that even simple, inexpensive cameras can use antireflection-treated lenses.\nTreating the ice cracks described in the source as thin layers requires very thin air gaps, suitable illumination, and reflected light from both sides that can overlap.\n\nColoured glints are a possible observation under these conditions, not a feature guaranteed for every fracture.\nThis thin-layer idea does not let us simply reuse the coating's thickness rule.\nThe source describes an observation, not a request to make cracks.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 222,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0232#4"
      ],
      "source_text": "光谱边缘部分的光——红光和紫光的反射削弱不显著.所以光学增透的镜头其反射光中，都具有淡紫色调. 现在甚至简单的便宜的摄影机都具有光学增透.",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    },
    {
      "kind": "p",
      "text": "Light cancelling light means that the combined vibration becomes smaller in a particular direction, not that light energy is destroyed or that interference itself turns it into heat.\nAs with mechanical-wave interference, a dark region receives less energy because the distribution of energy flow has changed.\n\nIn the transparent, non-absorbing ideal model used here, energy removed from reflection goes into transmission.\nFor the selected wavelength, complete cancellation of reflection with no other losses lets all incident energy pass forwards through the lens;\nin a real instrument, absorption or other losses prevent us from concluding that weak reflection alone means complete transmission.",
      "id": null,
      "label": null,
      "printed_page": 222,
      "source_refs": [
        "p0232#5"
      ],
      "source_text": "在结尾时我们要着重指出用光来抵消光不意味着光能转化为其它形式的能. 正象在机械波干涉时一样，在空间某一部分波的相互抵消意味着光能根本没传到这里. 因而，反射波的相抵消意味着全部光透过物镜(镜头).",
      "changes": [
        "translation",
        "explanation",
        "layout"
      ],
      "numeric_changes": [],
      "historical_entities": []
    }
  ],

          "text": "有一些专门仪器——干涉仪，其作用是以干涉现象为基础的. 它们的用途可以是各种各样的：精确地测定光的波长、气体的折射率等等，还有专门用途的干涉仪.",

          "text": "我们仅讲述干涉的两种应用.",
          "id": null,
          "label": null,
          "printed_page": 220,
          "source_refs": [
            "p0230#5"
          ]
        },

          "kind": "p",
          "text": "**表面加工质量的检验**　利用干涉可以评定零件表面加工的质量，精确度可达 $\\frac{1}{10}$ 波长，即精确到 $10^{-6}$ 厘米. 为此，在样品的表面和一个很光滑的标准平面之间造成一个薄的楔形空气层(图 201). 表面不光洁度达 $10^{-6}$ 厘米时，光从被检验表面和它下面的标准板反射时就会产生干涉条纹的明显的弯曲.",

          "text": "**光学增透**　现代摄影机和电影放映机的镜头，潜水艇的潜望镜和各种其他光学装置都是由大量的光学玻璃——透镜、棱镜等等组成. 光通过这些装置时，要从很多表面反射. 现代的摄影镜头反射面超过 $10$ 个，而在潜水艇的潜望镜里达到$40$ 个. 在光垂直入射到表面上时，能从表面反射全部能量的$5$—$9\\%$. 所以通过仪器的常常只是光入射能量的 $10$—$20\\%$.因此像的照度很小. 此外，像的质量也变差. 部分光束在由内表面多次反射以后，仍然通过光学仪器，但是发散了，并且不再参与形成清晰的像. 例如，在摄影机的图像里，由于这种原因而形成了“翳影”.",

          "kind": "p",
          "text": "光学增透是以干涉为基础的. 在光学玻璃(如透镜)表面，涂上一层薄膜，其折射率 $n_{\\text{膜}}$ 小于玻璃的折射率 $n_{\\text{玻}}$. 为了简便，我们来研究光垂直入射到薄膜上的情况(图 $202$).",
